weeks.content:
Let the children come
I matter to Jesus

The sick are made well
Caring for the sick

The good Samaritan
Be a neighbour

God looks for us
Never give up on anyone

Five loaves and two fish
Sharing with others

The Lord's prayer
My prayer habits

The ten lepers
Say thank you

Do not steal or lie
Truthful living

Sorry and forgiveness
God welcomes back

Recite our verses
Songs of praise
